agenda_items: Review of recent regional test drive campaign performance and conversion metrics
Dealer partnership program updates and co-marketing opportunities
Social media content calendar approval for next 6 months
Brand positioning strategy for competitive market challenges
Analysis of customer engagement trends across digital and dealership channels
key_decisions: Confirmed partnership with regional automotive influencers for brand awareness initiative
